title: Split components.rs into clustering/identity/anchors modules
description: Split src/components.rs (1296 lines, cognitive 56) into a components/ module directory: clustering.rs (adjacency, Louvain, auto-tune), identity.rs (reconcile, detect_events, staleness), anchors.rs (scoring, name alignment, concept density), mod.rs (config + discover_components orchestration). Pure file moves, no logic change, public interface unchanged. Isolates anchor heuristics (slated for human-confirmation churn) from clustering core.

messages.author: codex
messages.text: Codex review: approve with notes. One finding (high): LouvainResult was pub before the split but is no longer reachable as components::LouvainResult after — it lives in private mod clustering with no re-export. Verified: zero external callers exist, so this is not a regression in practice. The type's pub was over-broad before; the split correctly narrowed it to pub(super) scope. No action needed.
